name: leo-starter-dashboard
title: Leo's starter: Dashboard from a spreadsheet
description: Drop, paste or load a CSV and get key numbers, charts and a searchable table. Runs entirely in the browser; data never leaves the device.
license: MIT (template code). Chart.js, Papa Parse, three.js and Governor are MIT, the font is OFL 1.1. See NOTICE.md.
author: Cardzo
stack: Web Animations API and View Transitions (no animation library)
sampleData: sample-sales.csv (fictional, 200 rows: date, region, product, units, revenue)
features: Drag and drop, file picker, or paste CSV
3D bar field on the start screen (three.js, lazy loaded, static fallback), reading state for big files
Comma, semicolon, tab and pipe separators, quoted fields
Detects number, date and category columns
Line chart over a date column with automatic day, week or month buckets
Bar chart with grouping chips and a view-transition cross-fade between groupings
Category filter and date range, with clear empty states
Keyboard shortcuts with a help list (press ?), instant when used from the keyboard
Sortable, searchable, paginated table; fast with 10,000 rows
Export chart as PNG and filtered rows as CSV (formula-safe)
Light and dark themes, reduced motion respected, mobile layout
No network calls with your data
Governor pre-installed: AI coding guardrails for Claude Code (tier 3)

demo.quick: Double-click index.html, then click 'Try the sample sales data'
